description:
A Windows 11 focused rebuild of GestureSign for touchpad and mouse gestures.

GestureSign V2 is a Windows 11 focused rebuild of the classic open-source GestureSign project. It supports touchpad gestures, touchscreen gestures, mouse gestures, gesture trails, per-app actions, ignore rules, tray controls, Smart Close, and bundled Kando radial menu quick actions.
- Fixed touchscreen edge actions incorrectly falling back to the opposite edge. A right-edge swipe no longer triggers an action assigned only to the left edge, and vertical edges are matched by their actual starting edge as well.
- Clarified mouse action position labels by distinguishing the first and last contact, with separate down and up positions.
- When Move Mouse is enabled, the selected contact can be used as the target position for mouse movement and right-click actions. Existing configurations remain compatible.
